newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia sells $68.9 million in treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia sells $68.9 million in treasury bills.

text.p: The central National Bank of Ethiopia auctioned $68.9 million in 91-day treasury bills.
It said in a Thursday advertisement in the English-language daily The Ethiopian Herald that an auction committee considered seven bids with a total value of $131.8 million in bills.
The weighted yield rate was 3.82 percent compared to 3.89 percent at the last auction in September.
The bank said the treasury bills were dated 16 October 1996 and would mature on 15 January 1997.
